title: Robinson Crusoe (II/II)
summary: "Robinson Crusoe (II/II)" by Daniel Defoe is the second part of an adventure novel first published in 1719. After 28 years marooned on a remote tropical island, Crusoe has survived storms, cannibals, and isolation. Now, with his companion Friday, he faces new threats as cannibals return and an English ship arrives carrying mutineers.
